notes.title: Vesper: Zero Light Edition out now!
notes.content:
[i]Do not go gentle into that good Vesper,
The children of men burn and rave at close of day;
Rage, rage against the rise of the Zero Light.[/i]

Vesper: Zero Light Edition is [b]OUT NOW[/b] as a free update for Vesper on PC.

[list]
[*] Updated puzzles and level design
[*] An unlockable Artbook with preliminary sketches and study
[*] New in-game assets and sprites
[*] Rebalanced gameplay
[/list]

Enjoy Vesper: Zero Light Edition on PC!

Moreover, the new DLC called Vesper: The Age of Zero Light - that features an exclusive book of the game that consists of a curated version of the in-game story, along with stills from cutscenes, ingame events, concept art sketches and a deep-lore timeline - is out now. If you're a die-hard fan of the game, you can't miss it for sure!

We’ll meet again in the Great Beyond, one day.

Cheers,
[i]Cordens Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Vesper: Zero Light Edition ready to drop on 12th May 2022!
notes.content:
[b]TITLE: !!!WARNING!!! ZERO LIGHT CONTAINMENT FAILED[/b]

It all began with a blessing.

In the ancient times the Children of the Makers were wandering around the galaxy, with no purpose, nothing to live or die for. 

The Pure Light was their gift, a blessing from their creators, a boon which let them rise above all the living things. They built floating cities, and marvelous machines, spreading their knowledge and wisdom anywhere they went. 

But the ancient evil, the everlasting darkness, waiting in silence at the edge of the universe, also craved for that light. They called it… the Zero Light.

Vesper: Zero Light Edition is coming as a free update for Vesper on PC.

[list]
[*] Updated puzzles and level design
[*] An unlockable Artbook with preliminary sketches and study
[*] New in-game assets and sprites
[*] Rebalanced gameplay
[/list]

Moreover, a new DLC called Vesper: The Age of Zero Light - that features an exclusive book of the game that consists of a curated version of the in-game story, along with stills from cutscenes, ingame events, concept art sketches and a deep-lore timeline - will come out the same day, on 12th May 2022.

Enjoy Vesper: Zero Light Edition on PC, launching on 12th May 2022.

We’ll meet again in the Great Beyond, one day.

Cheers,
[i]Cordens Interactive[/i]

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hi humans!

We are releasing a small patch to address the most common issues some of you are experiencing with the Demo.

Thank you for everyone that played it in the last few days and took some time to provide feedback.
Here's is a short list of what changes with the new patch:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with final cutscene not showing up correctly.
[*] Fixed compatibility with screen aspect ratios different from 16:9.
[*] Added checkpoint to last part of the demo to prevent frustration from dying because of a Sentinel.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]

As always, if you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist!

Until next time,
Tom
